## Cybersecurity Compliance Checklist (required)
- [ ] No secrets or credentials added (tokens/keys/passwords/certs/connection strings/auth headers)
- [ ] No restricted/confidential data added to repo artifacts
- [ ] Repo security posture not weakened (no scan/branch protection bypass)
- [ ] Code scanning results reviewed (if enabled for this repo)
- [ ] Dependency scanning results reviewed (if enabled for this repo)
- [ ] Secret scanning results reviewed (if enabled for this repo)
- [ ] Any vulnerability findings are remediated OR explicitly documented as an exception with approval
